blocking_findings.finding: quiet() only queries list-jobs if camera/GUI has a Job, and only checks those two rows. It accepts an extra same-boot aura-boot-wide-<boot>-load.service start waiting with no client PID. If camera/GUI has no Job, it does not query the queue at all. daemon_owner() also accepts active/running daemon with a pending lifecycle Job.
blocking_findings.consequence: A queued OS-owned action has no process yet, so empty /proc/resource scans do not block it. A new DFX stage or stable-platform claim may advance while another queued loader or daemon stop/restart can later run. Per-action intent/InvocationID protects one attempt, not the whole relevant platform queue.
minimal_fix: At every advancing DFX/ID_STOP boundary and stable-platform gate, audit all relevant platform jobs even when camera/GUI Job is empty. Ordinary unrelated OS jobs should remain outside this bounded classification.
Keep the exact camera/GUI ordered-start allowlist; reject unexplained queued/running aura-boot-wide-* and pending lifecycle jobs for dfx-mgr/repaired-ZOCL/approved auxiliary loaders.
An owned in-flight action must match its durable intent and exact InvocationID; observe that same attempt, never dispatch another action while it is pending or unknown.
Require daemon Job empty and no unexpected control helper before advancing. Preserve no-force/no-restart behavior.
Add only targeted pure negatives for extra queued loader, no camera/GUI jobs plus queued loader, and active daemon pending stop/restart.
